integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Deterministic computation is used only as a finite diagnostic stress test and is not treated as proof. The exact value had been proposed nonrigorously in 2016; this result supplies a global proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to planar Euclidean ellipses and does not address the rectangle, regular-hexagon, Reuleaux-triangle, or arbitrary-convex-quadrilateral cases.
No uniqueness classification of all maximizing boundary quadruples is claimed.
An older unpublished thesis cited by the primary source was not independently inspected; the later paper based on it still gives only ellipse bounds.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant of an ellipse
